name: fpay-monorepo
_comment_workspaces: apps/mobile is deliberately excluded — its deps cost ~169MB and no mobile work is planned. Its source is untouched; add 'apps/mobile' back here and run yarn install to resume (then `npx expo prebuild -p android` to regenerate the native project).

scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' EXIT; yarn dev:backend & yarn workspace @fpay/web dev & yarn workspace @fpay/admin dev & yarn workspace @fpay/landing dev & wait
scripts.dev:web: trap 'kill 0' EXIT; yarn dev:backend & yarn workspace @fpay/web dev & wait
scripts.dev:admin: trap 'kill 0' EXIT; yarn dev:backend & yarn workspace @fpay/admin dev & wait
scripts.dev:landing: trap 'kill 0' EXIT; yarn dev:backend & yarn workspace @fpay/landing dev & wait
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @fpay/shared tsc --noEmit && yarn workspace @fpay/backend tsc --noEmit && yarn workspace @fpay/web tsc --noEmit && yarn workspace @fpay/admin tsc --noEmit && yarn workspace @fpay/landing tsc --noEmit
